title: Copy and Extend Patterns
seo_title: Grade R Patterns Worksheets with Answers (CAPS Maths)
standard_text: Copy and extend simple patterns using physical objects and drawings (e.g. using colour and shape); create own patterns.
meta_desc: Free CAPS Grade R maths worksheets: copy and extend repeating patterns, the part that repeats and what is missing. 100 questions with pictures and memos.
body_html:
How to think about it

  • A pattern repeats the same part again and again.
  • Say the pattern out loud: red, blue, red, blue …
  • Find the part that repeats.
  • Continue from the last item.

Examples

Example

circle, square, circle, square, …

circle, square repeats

Answer: circle

Common mistakes

MistakeWhat to do instead
The wrong placeContinue from the end.
Not repeatingThe part must repeat exactly.
SkippingCheck every item.

faq.a: The Reception Year, the year before Grade 1 and the first year of the Foundation Phase. Learners are about 5 to 6 years old.

faq.q: Which patterns are in Grade R?
faq.a: Simple repeating patterns made with objects, drawings, sounds and actions.

faq.q: What is the core of a pattern?
Can learners make their own patterns?
faq.a: Yes. CAPS asks them to copy, extend and create patterns.

items.q: Which pattern is made the same way as red, blue, red, blue, red, blue?
c: green, yellow, green, yellow, green, yellow
circle, square, triangle, circle, square, triangle
dog, dog, cat, dog, dog, cat
red, blue, blue, red, blue, blue
items.e: Both are one, then another, again and again patterns: the parts repeat in the same way. green, yellow, green, yellow, green, yellow.
